description: The Linux sandbox permits workspace and private tmp writes but blocks a host Unix socket.

setup_home_files.config.toml:
provider = "vllm"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1"
model = "e2e-model"
[sandbox]
enabled = true
mode = "workspace-write"

arguments.command: test -S host.sock && test -S host-dgram.sock && echo written > sandbox-created.txt && touch /tmp/nur-test && (python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); s.connect("host.sock")' && echo SOCKET_ESCAPED || echo SOCKET_BLOCKED) && (python3 -c 'import socket; a,b=socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); a.sendmsg([b"escape"],[],0,"host-dgram.sock")' && echo DGRAM_ESCAPED || echo DGRAM_BLOCKED) && (python3 -c 'import socket; a,b=socket.socketpair(socket.AF_UNIX,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); a.sendto(b"escape","host-dgram.sock")' && echo SENDTO_ESCAPED || echo SENDTO_BLOCKED) && python3 -c 'import socket; a,b=socket.socketpair(); a.send(b"ok"); assert b.recv(2)==b"ok"' && echo IPC_OK
